name: SeatLegend
description: Shown above the seat map: one row per seat type with its glyph and the price range for the active passenger on this flight, then the statuses.

evidence: Content and order documented; no props.

rules: One row per type: static Seat + type name + price range for the active passenger ("Preferred · from USD 15", or "Included").
Then the statuses: Selected, Occupied, Unavailable.
Each type shows its glyph (Preferred star, Extra Legroom arrows-vertical, Twin users).
Prices come from the seat-map API.
